units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 147a:8">B. Bath. 147ᵃ</cite> <he>בצ׳ בעלמא</he> by mere expression of his will (without symbolical possession); a. e.—Pl. <he>צַוָּאוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 15b:26">Ber. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>וכתבתם</he> … <he>אפי׳ צ׳</he> ‘and thou shalt write them’ (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:9">Deut. VI, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Deuteronomy 11:20">XI, 20</cite>) the entire section must be written out (in the T’fillin), including the orders (‘thou shalt write’, ‘ye shall bind’ &c.).

<cite ref="Deuteronomy 11:20">Ib.</cite> (ref. to the roll written for the Soṭah, <cite ref="Numbers 5:23">Num. V, 23</cite>) <he>אלות … צ׳ אינו כותב</he> the priest writes the curses but not the instructions; <cite ref="Sotah 17a">Sot. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ וקבלות</he> (not <he>צוואת</he>) the instructions and the affirmations (by the woman saying Amen).
